findings.title: All app imports are still started eagerly
findings.body: Each `import()` is evaluated while this object is initialized, so importing `app-store` immediately starts loading every app module rather than loading an app only when its entry is used. This defeats the intended lazy-loading benefit and keeps startup work and module loading for unused integrations.

findings.title: Calendar and video cancellation is not awaited
findings.body: The async callbacks passed to `forEach` are not awaited or collected. Since resolving the calendar now requires an asynchronous import, this function can send the reschedule email and return before calendar/video cancellations run; import or cancellation failures also escape the surrounding `try/catch`. A cancelled booking can therefore remain on an external calendar or retain its video meeting.

findings.title: Calendar and video cancellation is not awaited
findings.body: The async callbacks passed to `forEach` are not awaited or collected. Since resolving the calendar now requires an asynchronous import, this function can send the reschedule email and return before calendar/video cancellations run; import or cancellation failures also escape the surrounding `try/catch`. A cancelled booking can therefore remain on an external calendar or retain its video meeting.

findings.title: Reschedule mutation does not wait for integration cancellations
findings.body: The async callbacks passed to `forEach` are not awaited or collected. With `getCalendar` now awaiting a dynamic import, the mutation can proceed to send its email and return before calendar or video cancellation has started or completed. This can leave the old booking active in an external calendar or video service after the reschedule is reported as successful.
